definitions.explanation: The ability to form mental images or concepts of things not present or not real.

examples.japanese: {想像|そうぞう}していたより{大|おお}きかった。
examples.english: It was bigger than I imagined.

examples.japanese: {想像|そうぞう}{力|りょく}が{豊|ゆた}かだ。

notes:
Functions as a noun and with する as a verb ({想像|そうぞう}する = to imagine).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{想像|そうぞう}する (to imagine)
・{想像|そうぞう}できる (can imagine)
・{想像|そうぞう}できない (can't imagine)
・{想像|そうぞう}していた (was imagining/expected)
・{想像|そうぞう}{力|りょく} (imagination power)
・{想像|そうぞう}どおり (as imagined)

Note: Don't confuse with {創造|そうぞう} (creation) which has the same reading.
